title: Cities: Skylines | Franklin, Episode 8: TRAINS!
premise: Donoteat uses Franklin's new railroads to argue that transformative speed coexisted with unsafe operations, land speculation, charter loopholes, fragmented private networks and dangerous labor; historical claims remain attributed to the presenter.
coverage: Entire supplied ASR read; all 35 original contact sheets and 416 original indexed frames inspected, plus all 3 newly registered supplemental sheets/frames (417–419), totaling 38 sheets and 419 registered frames. Seven native stills inspected at 360, 370.9, 372.5, 558.8, 977.8, 1008.4 and 1360.6 seconds. Original sampling: first frame per 5-second bin plus FFmpeg scene score >0.30 at 480px detection width. Supplementary QA recovered the Whyte/white title-disclaimer gag and B&O emblem between original samples; both were directly reread and added through the authorized helper. Full speech is source-derived by the shared renderer from every timestamped transcript word, assigned by panel-start boundaries; no authored dialogue excerpts or end times remain. Machine speech/timing errors remain possible. Sparse samples may miss brief gags; camera movement is described only where adjacent inspected frames support it. Sound annotations identify metadata-specified music with approximate sequence placement; empty sound arrays mean unannotated, not silence. No direct audio-effect listening or independent historical fact check is claimed. Evidence links are in story-sheets/0tLxb5rtmyM.md.

panels.heading: Primal craving
panels.description: A single DNE token sits in a black field while the narrator builds suspense.
panels.camera: Static central logo across frames 2–8; no camera movement established.
panels.visualGag: Spoken addiction setup; the visual payoff is the next panel.

panels.heading: TRAINS reveal
panels.description: Huge TRAINS lettering appears over a monochrome photograph of two locomotives.
panels.camera: Hard cut from logo to static card.
panels.visualGag: The dramatic craving monologue resolves into this oversized rail-enthusiast punchline.
panels.notes: The TRAINS card is observed at indexed 39.1 seconds; this panel boundary groups the approaching spoken reveal, not a claim of exact cut onset.

sound.text: Title music: Beethoven Symphony no. 5 finale (IV. Allegro), identified by source metadata. Approximate placement at title sequence; onset not independently listened or frame-aligned.

panels.visualGag: Prelude to the connected Whyte/white homophone gag: the coming THE WHYTE SYSTEM title is followed by a disclaimer about racism. This gameplay image itself is not the payoff.

panels.heading: Whyte system / white-system setup
panels.description: Large white THE WHYTE SYSTEM lettering overlays the overhead siding build; no disclaimer is yet present in this selected frame.
panels.camera: Text overlay on overhead gameplay. Native still at 370.9 is closer to the sidings than the later 372.5 view; exact continuous zoom path is not reconstructed.
panels.action: Track-selection circles and gameplay interface remain visible while the title stays centered.
panels.visualGag: Setup for the next disclaimer payoff: the classification name Whyte sounds like white, creating a possible racial reading. This title-only state is followed by NOT A RACIST THING, JUST THE GUY'S NAME.
panels.notes: Actual registered source frame 417 at 370.9; native reread directly inspected. The panel boundary groups the narrated classification introduction, not a verified exact title onset.

panels.heading: Whyte disclaimer payoff
panels.description: THE WHYTE SYSTEM now has a second line: (NOT A RACIST THING, JUST THE GUY'S NAME), over the same railway-build gameplay.
panels.camera: Centered title and new subtitle over a wider overhead gameplay framing than the 370.9 setup still. No separate character-camera shot.
panels.action: The added subtitle is the observed graphic change between native rereads; gameplay selection interface remains visible.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the preceding Whyte/white homophone setup: an unsolicited anti-racist disclaimer clarifies that the name refers to a person. The next Thomas panel returns to the straight classification lesson.
panels.notes: Actual registered source frame 418 at 372.5; native reread confirms exact wording. Supplementary QA located the subtitle near 371.75; direct inspection establishes its presence at 372.5, not frame-exact onset. The original 5-second samples missed this overlay.

panels.heading: Baltimore and Ohio monopoly holder
